web-guide-idea-34.audience: Job seekers preparing for a role you understand.
web-guide-idea-34.offer: Offer a realistic rehearsal with specific feedback on answers. Your relevant experience matters more than generic interview tips.
web-guide-idea-34.steps.0: Request the role description and agree a practice focus.
web-guide-idea-34.steps.1: Run a short mock interview without interrupting every answer.
web-guide-idea-34.steps.2: Review examples and practise one improved response.
web-guide-idea-34.equipment: A camera phone and quiet room can work. A laptop makes reviewing notes and the job description easier.
web-guide-idea-34.returnReason: People may book another rehearsal after revising their answers or before a different interview round.
web-guide-idea-34.promotion: Share a sample question and explain how you give feedback. Never promise selection or employment.

web-guide-idea-34.metadataDescription: Use your relevant experience to run a mock interview and give specific, constructive feedback. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
